description: This file defines the abstract class Zend_Uri, which provides a base interface and common mechanisms for URI handling in the Zend Framework. It includes methods for creating URI objects, validating URIs, and managing URI schemes.

classes.name: Zend_Uri
classes.description: Abstract class providing a generic interface for URI handling, including URI creation, validation, and string representation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string, invoking getUri() or handling exceptions.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a given URI string is well-formed without creating a URI object.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a URI object based on the given URI string; supports different schemes and subclasses.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the scheme part of the URI.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets global configuration options for URI handling.
